questions.question: Which fields should capture.mjs record for each hook payload? Pick all that apply.

options.label: Timestamp
options.description: ISO time the payload was captured (recorded today, except on fallback lines).

options.label: Session ID
options.description: The session_id from the hook payload, pulled up to the top level.

options.label: Tool name
options.description: The tool_name from the payload, so lines are easy to filter.

options.label: Raw payload
options.description: The full original JSON payload, unchanged.
